At the outset, I must advert to an issue which, although not raised in the Criminal Applications before the Hon'ble High Court, would go to root of the matter.
VCA is a trust registered under the Maharashtra Public Trusts Act.

"Person".-The word "person" includes any Company or Association or body of persons, whether incorporated or not.
